newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian wool indicator drops 9 cents to 695c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australian wool indicator drops 9 cents to 695c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator fell nine cents to 695 cents a kg clean on Wednesday at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International said.
The drop took the indicator below 700 cents a kg for the first time since late May.
Merino fleece was mostly cheaper, with 19/21 microns 1.5 percent down, 20m two percent down, 22/25m one percent down, 23m 2.5 percent down, 24m slightly down and 26m 0.5 percent dearer.
Merino skirtings of 19/20m were firm but those of 21/22m were slightly cheaper.
In crossbreds, 27/28m were 0.5 percent cheaper, 29m 1.5 percent cheaper and 30/31m 0.5 percent dearer.
In cardings, lambs were unchanged with locks and crutchings firm.
WI said Western Europe and Japanese interests were principal buyers with good support from most sectors of the trade.
Of the 28,473 bales offered, 17.8 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in Sydney and Melbourne with about 30,370 bales to be offered.
